detail: Only 25 Dodgers amateur rows can carry a 7-season label (classes 2015, 2018, 2019; none for 2016-2017 or before 2015 outside the outcome-selected set). Support needs 25 more labels and 8 more positives; at the observed Dodgers rate (2/25) 10 positives imply roughly 125 labelled rows. DISI already registers the expected size of three mature classes with members missing (2013: 47 of 47 missing, 2016: 26 of 26 missing, 2019: 47 of 50 missing): up to 120 signees (fewer if some are professional-route), 120 of them past the 7-season horizon and 73 past the 10-season horizon. Loading and auditing them could by itself clear the 50-row minimum; whether it clears 10 positives depends on how many reached MLB. No CLASS_MEMBERS_MISSING task exists for any other mature class; this audit did not check whether those classes have a registered size.
143 of 168 Dodgers in-scope rows are CENSORED for the 7-season target (2021+ classes; the 2021 class labels after the 2028 season, 2022 after 2029). No research shortens this; it is a waiting cost.

Best case (REACH pooled): 34 positives against 60 needed for the 6-feature logistic; the population-stratified rate has no out-of-time skill. The benchmark already covers every mature class 2013-2019 (Top 30); more events need deeper lists or a league census, not more classes.
0 of 168 Dodgers in-scope rows have a pre-signing expectation band versus 151 of 169 benchmark rows, so is_top_expectation_band and is_top_prospect_sample are confounded with population.
10-season targets label only 2016-and-earlier signings: 11 Dodgers rows (1 positive bWAR, 0 Dodgers-value positive). DODGERS_MLB_VALUE gates the only expected-value model.
BWAR_2 benchmark support is one positive short; the 4 deferred 2016 reachers are the only near-term source of that positive (post-2026 capture).
3 labelled Dodgers reach rows lack market and 1 lacks position, so 21 of 25 enter the evaluation.
Of the 127 Dodgers OUTCOME_AUDIT tasks, these are signings less than 5 years old: no outcome can be final and every target is censored. The 7 mature ones are the v_dodgers_mature_outcome_queue row.
The three unresolved benchmark identities (Yrizarry, Rosario, Amundaray); each blocks a reach label and both bWAR labels.

Cost is excluded from the 041 feature set by design and resolving it adds no label. Many small international bonuses were probably never reported, but the schema cannot mark a value UNDISCLOSED, so no row is classified that way.
Benchmark costs never enter a Dodgers estimate or a 041 feature.
